title.value: L'azzurro e il Cremisi! Un incontro del destino

overview.value: Two of the mightiest warlords of ancient Japan, Takeda Shingen and Uesugi Kenshin, set aside their rivalry to unite against the forces of Date Masamune.
Sanada and Date rush to claim the same prize: Imagawa’s head. A clash erupts between the two warriors, but before one can declare victory, their battle is interrupted by a horrifying presence.
Free-spirited Keiji hopes to build an alliance against the threat of the Demon Lord. His visit with Uesugi ends on a promising note - but his meeting with Date Masamune leads to a battle.

title.value: Il tremante fiore scarlatto - La lealtà portatrice di dolore!

overview.value: The alliance is gathering strength; former rivals are united in the march to war against Oda. Unfortunately, the plan could be doomed without the cooperation and troops of Azai Nagamasa - Oda’s brother-in-law.

title.value: Eroico! Crociata sulla pianura Shitaraga di Nagashino

overview.value: As entire armies stand poised to attack, Takeda and Uesugi offer Tokugawa a final chance to join forces against Oda - but once his loyalties are decided, a ruthless betrayal soaks the battlefield in blood.

title.value: Legami infranti, lo sfortunato ritiro di Masamune!

overview.value: After he rises to defend the honor of the fallen Azai, Date Masamune orders his forces to retreat. However, Sanada is shocked to discover it might already be too late for the warrior to survive.

title.value: Il saccheggio del villano! Due draghi duellano sotto il chiaro di luna

overview.value: Matsunaga takes three of Date’s men hostage and demands a ransom of rare and valuable weaponry. Katakura sets out to rescue the men - but he might not be able to do it alone.

title.value: Il Grande Tempio di Sangue e Sento! Kojurou in una situazione disperata

overview.value: Katakura, Sanada, and Sarutobi arrive with the treasures requested by Matsunaga, who betrays his word and attacks the hostages.

title.value: La Tigre del Kai muore a Midaigawa

overview.value: Oda’s army is on the move in the south, while his most lethal assassins strike the opposition leaders of the east. As Takeda and Uesugi fight for their lives, many loyal to the alliance meet their demise.

title.value: Yukimura incapace di risollevare il proprio animo?! L'incredibile scioglimento delle forze di Date

overview.value: With Takeda and Uesugi injured, the remaining alliance leaders plot their final assault against Oda. Even though the situation looks bleak, Date and Sanada prepare to face their destinies.

title.value: Il tradimento di Mitsuhide! Honnouji in fiamme!

overview.value: Date and Sanada arrive at Honnoji, but the showdown with evil will have to wait - the Demon Lord has set a trap. Meanwhile, a voice from beyond the grave encourages Ichi to take action against Oda.

title.value: La torre del castello Azuki. Battaglia mortale per il futuro!

overview.value: The incredible final battle explodes at Azuchi Castle! With amazing power and determination, Date and Sanada unleash against the mighty Demon Lord.
